docs.title: jaxmapse
docs.text:
JAX-based implementation of the MAtter Power Spectrum Emulator (Mapse), mirroring the Mapse.jl repository.

This package provides high-performance, differentiable emulators for the matter power spectrum, specifically designed for use in JAX-based cosmological inference pipelines.
